operations.name: userFlagUpdate
operations.description: Updates a specific user settings flag by performing an operation (e.g., increment or clear) on it.

operations.name: userRevokeAllSessions
operations.description: Revokes all active sessions for a user, forcing them to re-authenticate. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

operations.name: userRevokeSession
operations.description: Revokes a specific authentication session for a user. The admin cannot revoke their own sessions with this mutation. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

operations.name: userSettingsFlagsReset
operations.description: Resets one or more of the user's setting flags. If no specific flags are provided, all flags are reset.

operations.name: userSettingsUpdate
operations.description: Updates the authenticated user's settings, including notification preferences, email subscriptions, theme, and other UI preferences.

operations.name: userSuspend
operations.description: Suspends a user, deactivating their account and revoking access to the workspace. The suspended user's sessions are invalidated. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

operations.name: userUnlinkFromIdentityProvider
operations.description: Unlinks a guest user from their identity provider. Can only be called by an admin when SCIM is enabled.

operations.name: userUnsuspend
operations.description: Re-activates a suspended user, restoring their access to the workspace. Can only be called by a workspace admin or owner.

operations.name: userUpdate
operations.description: Updates a user's profile information. Users can update their own profile; workspace admins can update any user's profile. SCIM-managed users may have restricted name changes.

operations.name: viewPreferencesCreate
operations.description: Creates a new view preferences object. If conflicting preferences already exist for the same view type and scope, the existing preferences are replaced.

operations.name: viewPreferencesDelete
operations.description: Deletes a view preferences object. If the preferences do not exist, the operation is treated as a successful idempotent deletion.

operations.name: viewPreferencesUpdate
operations.description: Updates an existing view preferences object. For user-type preferences, only the owning user can update them.

operations.name: webhookCreate
operations.description: Creates a new webhook subscription for the workspace. Requires specifying a URL, resource types to subscribe to, and either a specific team or all public teams.

operations.name: webhookDelete
operations.description: Deletes a Webhook.

operations.name: webhookRotateSecret
operations.description: Rotates the signing secret for a webhook, generating a new HMAC-SHA256 key and returning it. The old secret is immediately invalidated.

operations.name: webhookUpdate
operations.description: Updates an existing Webhook.

operations.name: workflowStateArchive
operations.description: Archives a state. Only states with issues that have all been archived can be archived.

operations.name: workflowStateCreate
operations.description: Creates a new state, adding it to the workflow of a team.

operations.name: workflowStateUpdate
operations.description: Updates a state.
